description: DC-005 style barrel jack, 5.5mm outer / 2.1mm inner diameter, through-hole with 3 contacts (center pin + outer sleeve + switch). Standard DC power input for embedded boards. Built-in normally-closed switch detects plug insertion.
name: dc-barrel-jack-5-5-2-1
watch_out_for: Center-positive is standard but verify your wall adapter. Switch contact allows battery/DC auto-switching: connect battery to switch pin and load from center pin. Not suitable above 24V/3A. Add reverse-polarity protection on the input rail.
